patterns.name: Authority Drift
patterns.problem: Multiple layers or systems can mutate or reinterpret the same business fact.
failed_approaches: Treat browser state as equal authority
Maintain overlapping local and provider commercial truths
Infer operational truth from convenience projections
patterns.successful_pattern: Declare one authoritative writer per mutable fact and make all other representations read models, evidence or caches.
patterns.general_rule: If two components can independently make the same business fact true, the model is already inconsistent.

patterns.name: Snapshot Writes Hide Intent
patterns.problem: Clients upload aggregate state rather than a bounded business intent.
failed_approaches: Last-write-wins whole-state persistence
Implicit mutation through shared day-state blobs
patterns.successful_pattern: Command boundary with aggregate ID, expected revision, idempotency key, actor/device and server invariant checks.
patterns.general_rule: Persist intent, not a stale client reconstruction of the world.

patterns.name: Client Ordering Is Not Concurrency Control
patterns.problem: Single-device serialization can hide but not solve cross-device races.
failed_approaches: Serialized client polling/writes as final concurrency solution
Timestamp-only ordering
patterns.successful_pattern: Use monotonic read cursor for transport plus independent server revision/CAS and idempotency for mutation.
patterns.general_rule: Ordering, freshness, conflict detection and replay safety are separate invariants.

patterns.name: Retry Ambiguity
patterns.problem: A client cannot know whether a timed-out consequential request committed.
failed_approaches: Generate a new command ID on every retry
Assume network failure means server failure
patterns.successful_pattern: Stable command ID tied to normalized intent, immutable result ledger and explicit APPLIED/REPLAYED/CONFLICT outcomes.
patterns.general_rule: Unknown network outcome is a state, not a reason to generate a second side effect.

patterns.name: Missing Becomes a Lie
patterns.problem: Missing, stale or not-yet-established evidence is rendered as a valid business value.
failed_approaches: Null-to-zero fallback
Sample/demo fallback in production
Treat not commissioned as zero
Treat unavailable as empty
patterns.successful_pattern: Typed availability/quality states with confirmed zero preserved only when authority exists.
patterns.general_rule: A number can be syntactically valid and operationally false.

patterns.name: Identity and Unit Collapse
patterns.problem: Commercial identity, physical identity, package level and base quantity are treated as interchangeable.
failed_approaches: Assume commercial SKU proves physical brand shipped
Store converted base units as carton balance
Silently remap barcode identity
patterns.successful_pattern: Separate Commercial SKU, Physical SKU, barcode identity, package quantity and base-unit quantity with explicit conversion/substitution evidence.
patterns.general_rule: Identity and quantity must retain their grain and unit domain until an explicit governed conversion exists.

patterns.name: Integration Success Is Not Operational Truth
patterns.problem: Raw provider sync or API success is mistaken for projected, fresh, usable operational state.
failed_approaches: Advance read-model freshness despite zero relevant mutations
Assume raw rows imply current projection
Use stale derived cache after projection failure
patterns.successful_pattern: Separate raw landing, projection, read-model freshness and consumer acceptance; fail closed on stale decision surfaces.
patterns.general_rule: Each integration plane needs its own success evidence.

patterns.name: Unbounded Work Becomes Production Debt
patterns.problem: Jobs that are correct on small data fail or become expensive as history and steady-state usage grow.
failed_approaches: Single monolithic full-history job
Fixed large batch
Page RPC that scans full archive
Rewrite unchanged cache rows
Wake completed pipelines continuously
patterns.successful_pattern: Bounded pages/time slices, durable checkpoint/resume, adaptive batches, convergence probes, delta writes and steady-state cadence review.
patterns.general_rule: Bound both the active work and the cost of doing nothing.

patterns.name: False Green and Silent Failure
patterns.problem: The primary workflow appears successful while a required operational dependency is degraded.
failed_approaches: Log non-blocking read-model failure after authoritative projection
Collapse structured errors into strings
Repeat identical business blocker as technical failure email
patterns.successful_pattern: Typed errors, dependency-aware workflow status and separation of technical execution health from persistent business health.
patterns.general_rule: A green pipeline is a claim about a defined contract, not merely process exit code.

patterns.name: Field Device Capability Drift
patterns.problem: Warehouse/driver workflows assume browser, camera, GPS or connectivity capabilities that are not universal.
failed_approaches: Require native BarcodeDetector on Safari
Treat web GPS as guaranteed background tracking
Require online round-trip before preserving physical count
patterns.successful_pattern: Capability detection, pinned fallback, manual path, local evidence journal and explicit best-effort semantics.
patterns.general_rule: Field workflows must degrade to a safe useful mode, not to a dead screen or false completion.

patterns.name: UI Authorization Is Not Authorization
patterns.problem: Hiding or showing controls is treated as the permission boundary.
failed_approaches: Browser direct DML
Role inferred from sidebar wording
RPC replacement without reapplying server guards
patterns.successful_pattern: Server-owned role/capability checks, RLS/ACL denial and audited command boundary; UI consumes capability for guidance only.
patterns.general_rule: A malicious or stale client must be unable to gain authority by bypassing presentation logic.

patterns.name: Ideal Migration History Is Not Production
patterns.problem: CI replays a clean expected history while production contains legacy objects, types, privileges or formatting.
failed_approaches: Test only ideal migration sequence
Assume managed database has superuser privileges
Assume CREATE OR REPLACE can reshape existing view contract
Parse function definitions using fixture formatting
patterns.successful_pattern: Production-schema shadow, exact drift fixtures, non-superuser managed-role tests and forward compatibility migrations.
patterns.general_rule: Production history is an input to migration testing, not an inconvenience to normalize away.

patterns.name: Release Plane Confusion
patterns.problem: A successful PR/build is taken as evidence that database, function, projection or production are current.
failed_approaches: Deploy to wrong project while frontend is healthy
Use fixed delay between schema deploy and dependent data job
Infer DB rollout from Vercel/PR success
patterns.successful_pattern: Independent commit-linked statuses and ordered evidence for code, DB, functions, projection/data and production smoke.
patterns.general_rule: Release is a vector of versions and health, not a boolean.

patterns.name: DOM Enhancer Architecture Rot
patterns.problem: Legacy DOM replacement, text lookup and observers become hidden application interfaces.
failed_approaches: Lazy hide-and-replace dashboard
Role detection from branded text
Repeated observer wrapping
Text-based workspace navigation
patterns.successful_pattern: Typed route ownership, normal React tree, bounded overlay manager and one authenticated application shell.
patterns.general_rule: Presentation structure is not a stable integration API.

patterns.name: Analytics Without Governance Invents Authority
patterns.problem: Metrics and drill/actions appear available because the UI can calculate or display them, not because evidence permits them.
failed_approaches: Frontend aggregation across incompatible units
Treat DRAFT/SHADOW as READY
Infer drill/action authority from UI state
patterns.successful_pattern: Governed fact grain, metric registry, Shadow readiness, capability envelope, reconciliation and evidence-gated cutover.
patterns.general_rule: Analytical visibility and action authority are separately earned capabilities.

patterns.name: Agent Scope and Verification Drift
patterns.problem: Parallel agents can silently expand scope or claim completion based on their own local checks.
failed_approaches: Agent self-declares done
Tests exist but are not wired
Opportunistic adjacent fixes
patterns.successful_pattern: Bounded work package, file ownership, independent verification, required evidence chain and CI wiring audit.
patterns.general_rule: Builder and verifier must be institutionally separate even when both are AI agents.

patterns.name: Physical Evidence and Transaction Collapse
patterns.problem: Observation from the physical world directly mutates authoritative state without review/transaction boundary.
failed_approaches: Barcode mapping also receives stock
Count entry immediately overwrites balance
Infer fulfilment from default SKU mapping
patterns.successful_pattern: Capture evidence first; promote through controlled mapping/publication/receiving/approval/ledger transactions with immutable proof.
patterns.general_rule: Sensors and humans observe; governed commands decide what becomes business truth.

patterns.name: Engineering Acceptance Is Not Product Acceptance
patterns.problem: Static tests and builds pass while real-device layout, runtime load or field workflow remains unusable.
failed_approaches: Treat Vite/TypeScript green as visual completion
Skip real logged-in production acceptance
Treat semantic correction as safe because classifier tests pass
patterns.successful_pattern: Performance budgets, responsive states, real-device screenshots/smoke, production runtime isolation, rollback-first incident response and field acceptance.
patterns.general_rule: The final oracle for an operational product includes reality, not only code.
